name: Disney Wonder Alaska Regional Specials: Steamed King Crab Legs, Halibut & Glacier Day Salmon/Chowder
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Taste of Alaska Regional Specials & Dawes Glacier Deck BBQ
whyItWorks: Steamed Alaskan King Crab Legs ("Steamed Crab Royal"), pan-seared Alaskan Halibut, and Dawes Glacier Day grilled Wild Alaskan Salmon are zero-fiber, ultra-pure marine proteins.
